metadata.description: Comprehensive scholarship database for Bangladeshi CS/AI/ML students planning 2027-2029 intake for MSc/PhD abroad
metadata.targetProfile: Bangladeshi student, CS/AI/ML/Data Science/Robotics/Software Engineering, age 20-28, BSc completed or final year
metadata.criticalNote: Scholarship is not just financial aid - it determines visa eligibility, housing priority, post-study work rights activation, and PR pathway speed. A fully funded scholarship can save USD 80,000-200,000 over study duration and compress the entire GradPlanner timeline by 2-3 years.
metadata.scholarshipPhilosophy: For Bangladeshi students, the hierarchy is: (1) Full funding covering tuition+living, (2) Tuition-only with livable stipend from TA/RA, (3) Partial funding with part-time work supplement, (4) Self-funded only as last resort for high ROI destinations
metadata.bangladeshSpecificNote: Bangladesh is classified as a developing country / LDC (Least Developed Country) by UN until 2026 graduation. This LDC status opens specific scholarship windows at EU, UN, and bilateral programs. Apply strategically before LDC graduation status changes.

scholarships.scholarshipName: Netherlands Fellowship Programme (NFP) / Orange Knowledge Programme
scholarships.provider: Netherlands Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Nuffic
scholarships.bangladeshPriorityStatus: HIGH - Bangladesh is an OKP partner country with dedicated quota
scholarships.annualAwards: Approximately 30-50 for Bangladesh across all fields

eligibility.employerEndorsement: Must have employer or organization letter of support in Bangladesh

applicationProcess.process: Apply to Dutch university first → once conditionally admitted → apply for OKP scholarship
applicationProcess.typicalDeadline: February for September intake; some programs November deadline

returnObligation.duration: Must return to Bangladesh for at least 2 years post-study
returnObligation.enforcement: Bond/agreement signed; partial scholarship recovery if not returned
returnObligation.planningNote: This creates a complication for GradPlanner PR pathway. Consider: complete NFP MSc → return to BD 2 years → apply for Netherlands self-funded PhD or work → OR use the MSc to qualify for other country PR pathways

scholarships.recommendation: STRONG for MSc funding but return obligation conflicts with direct PR pathway. Best strategy: use OKP MSc to build credentials, then pursue PhD in Netherlands or Germany for PR pathway.

scholarships.annualAwards: Hundreds across Dutch universities; CS/AI particularly active
scholarships.competitionLevel: HIGH but manageable with strong profile

funding.tuitionCoverage: FULL - PhD is employment, not student status

monthlyGross.note: Year 1 of AIO (Assistant-in-Opleiding) scale; rises to EUR 3,670 by Year 4

netMonthlyEstimate.note: After 20% income tax + social security; effectively a job

funding.healthInsurance: Zorgtoeslag subsidy; employee arranges own ZVW insurance

eligibility.gpa: MSc degree (or near completion) with excellent grades
eligibility.publicationsRequired: Not mandatory but MSc thesis of high quality expected
eligibility.supervisorMatch: Must respond to specific advertised PhD position; or approach professor with proposal
eligibility.languageRequirement: English sufficient for research; Dutch not required
eligibility.bangladeshSpecific: No restrictions; Dutch universities actively recruit internationally

applicationProcess.aiSpecificGroups: ELLIS (European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems) units in Amsterdam, Eindhoven

strategicValue.prPathwayImpact: After 5 years employment (including PhD) → Netherlands permanent residency; 30% tax ruling for first 5 years
strategicValue.taxRuling30Percent: 30% ruling: 30% of salary tax-free as expatriate benefit; significantly increases net income
strategicValue.careerValue: Dutch PhD alumni highly valued at ASML, Philips, Booking.com, Adyen, TomTom
strategicValue.probabilityAssessment: For MSc graduates with strong thesis, publications, good English: 25-40% per position applied; apply to 10-15 positions

scholarships.recommendation: TIER 1 PRIORITY for PhD. The employment model (not scholarship) means full social benefits, pension, and the 30% ruling. Better financial package than most scholarships. Eindhoven and Amsterdam are prime targets.

scholarships.recommendation: ASPIRATIONAL TIER 1. If you have publications in NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR or equivalent, apply here first. ETH/EPFL PhD changes career trajectory permanently. Extremely competitive but worth pursuing alongside other applications.

scholarships.bangladeshEligibilityNote: US citizens and permanent residents ONLY. Not available to international students on F-1 visa. Noted for completeness - if student achieves US Green Card during studies, opens future eligibility.

scholarships.recommendation: Not applicable for Bangladeshi F-1 students. However, awareness important: if you marry a US citizen or get Green Card during studies, this window opens.

eligibility.bangladeshSpecific: No restrictions; significant Bangladeshi faculty at US universities (use this network)

applicationProcess.bangladeshiFacultyNetwork: Identify Bangladeshi professors at target universities via MIT/Stanford/CMU faculty pages; cold email is highly effective when done properly
applicationProcess.stemOPTNote: F-1 STEM OPT: 12 months OPT + 24 months STEM extension = 36 months work authorization; critical bridge to H-1B

strategicValue.careerCeiling: US PhD from top program creates highest career ceiling globally; Big Tech salary USD 200,000-500,000+ total compensation for senior AI roles
strategicValue.immigrationRisk: H-1B lottery 20-30% annual chance; EB-2 Green Card backlog potentially 20-40 years for Bangladesh-born; MAJOR long-term risk

scholarships.recommendation: TIER 1 for career maximization. MIT/CMU/Stanford PhD transforms everything. BUT treat as career launchpad, NOT settlement destination. Parallel-plan Canada PR from Year 1. The H-1B and Green Card situation is genuinely risky for long-term settlement.

scholarships.provider: Japanese Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology
scholarships.bangladeshPriorityStatus: MEDIUM - Bangladesh has bilateral education agreement with Japan
scholarships.annualAwards: Approximately 2,000 globally for research scholarships; Bangladesh receives 20-40 per year across all fields
scholarships.successRateEstimate: 5-10% for CS/AI applicants through Embassy recommendation

funding.tuitionCoverage: FULL - national university entrance fees and tuition waived
funding.totalAnnualValueUSD: 18000-24000 (stipend + tuition value; very competitive for Japan's cost structure)

eligibility.languageRequirement: Japanese OR English depending on program; Japanese proficiency not required for English-medium programs but recommended
eligibility.bangladeshSpecific: Apply through Japanese Embassy in Dhaka; Embassy Recommendation route (most accessible) or University Recommendation route (requires direct professor contact)

embassyRoute.process: Apply at Japanese Embassy Dhaka April-June annually; written exam + interview; embassy nominates candidates to MEXT
embassyRoute.examSubjects: Japanese language exam (or English for science applicants), mathematics, and subject-specific papers
embassyRoute.deadline: April-May annually for following April enrollment

universityRoute.process: Directly contact Japanese professor → professor recommends to MEXT → university submits recommendation
universityRoute.requirement: Must find professor willing to supervise before application

researchStudentPhase.description: Most MEXT scholars enter as 研究生 (kenkyusei - Research Student) for 6-12 months before formal MSc/PhD enrollment; use this phase to improve Japanese, settle in, and prepare for entrance exam
researchStudentPhase.importantNote: Research student status counts toward scholarship; stipend continues throughout

strategicValue.japaneseLaborMarketNote: MEXT scholars who learn Japanese (N2+) access Japan's enormous tech market with significant salary premium over English-only professionals
strategicValue.prPathwayImpact: Highly Skilled Professional (HSP) points system: MEXT degree + Japan university adds points → faster PR (1-3 years vs standard 5)
strategicValue.aiEcosystemAccess: Access to Sony AI, Toyota Research Institute, Preferred Networks, NTT, NEC, Fujitsu AI labs
strategicValue.probabilityAssessment: Bangladeshi applicants via embassy route with strong academic record: 10-20%; via professor introduction: 20-35%

scholarships.recommendation: TIER 1 for Japan pathway. MEXT is financially excellent for Japan's cost structure. Start Japanese language classes immediately - N3 by application, N2 target during study. Japan's immigration is opening; MEXT + Japanese fluency = strong long-term position. UTokyo and Kyoto University for AI/CS are globally competitive.

scholarships.recommendation: Apply simultaneously with KGSP. If KGSP not obtained, KAIST direct admission with RA funding is the next best path. Professor outreach is critical - identify specific KAIST professors whose research aligns with your interests.
